Choose existing approved voice/music assets first; a library miss is a visible choice to request an experiment, never permission to spend.

Evaluate coherence, depth, fidelity and voice independently. Record each status (pass, fail or not_checked), a concrete reason, affected item IDs, and supporting source/version references where available. Do not report unavailable checks as pass.
